title: Alien Girl on Floating Island
description: A green-skinned alien girl with pigtails stands on a mossy floating island, wearing a spacesuit and holding a small device. Behind her, a massive purple space serpent with glowing green eyes emerges from a swirling cosmic vortex featuring a black hole, a blue planet, and a futuristic cityscape below.
prompt: A green-skinned alien girl with black pigtails and pink bows stands on a moss-covered floating rock island dripping with green slime, wearing a detailed spacesuit and holding a gadget, a large translucent green slime creature with a smiley face floats beside her, in the background a giant purple dragon-like space serpent with glowing green eyes and open mouth emerges from swirling purple and pink nebula clouds, a large black hole with red fiery accretion disk, a blue planet, and a dark futuristic city with gothic spires under a red sky
